criteria.description: The reason why the client is seeking therapy or a description of symptoms.
criteria.title: Chief complaint

criteria.description: The client’s own description of their feelings, thoughts, and behaviors along with the severity.
criteria.title: Symptoms

criteria.description: Relevant background information, including any past medical, therapy, or behavioral issues.
criteria.title: History

criteria.description: What the client hopes to achieve through therapy.
criteria.title: Client's Goals

criteria.description: Reviewing homework from the previous sessions and note client’s compliance.
criteria.title: Homework from previous sessions

criteria.description: Direct quotes from the client capturing their exact words and emotional tone.
criteria.title: Quotes

criteria.description: The therapist's observations of the client's behavior, mood, appearance, and affect during the session.
criteria.title: Client’s observed behavior

criteria.description: Observations regarding the client’s appearance, speech, thought processes, and orientation.
criteria.title: Mental Status

criteria.description: Results from any standardized assessments or scales used during the session.
criteria.title: Assessment Tools

criteria.description: Description of specific interventions or activities conducted during the session.
criteria.title: Therapy Activities

criteria.description: Applied interventions and treatment plans (MI, Cognitive Restructuring, DBT, etc.). Focus on describing active interventions provided rather than passive ones.
criteria.title: Interventions

criteria.description: Any formal diagnoses made based on DSM-5 criteria or other diagnostic tools.
criteria.title: Diagnosis/Symptoms

criteria.description: Any triggers shown by the client.
criteria.title: Identifying Triggers

criteria.description: Evaluation of the client's progress toward their therapeutic goals.
criteria.title: Progress

criteria.description: The therapist's interpretation of how the client's subjective report and objective observations relate to their overall condition.
criteria.title: Analysis

criteria.description: The client's response to the provided interventions.
criteria.title: Response to interventions

criteria.description: Overall progress made by the client.
criteria.title: Overall/high-level progress

criteria.description: Specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound (SMART) goals for the client. Adjustment to the treatment goals.
criteria.title: Treatment Goals

criteria.description: Client's stage of change (Pre-contemplation, contemplation, action, maintenance, etc.).
criteria.title: Stages of change

criteria.description: Planned therapeutic techniques or strategies to be used in future sessions.
criteria.title: Future Interventions

criteria.description: Scheduling of the next session and any referrals to other professionals if needed. Note the date for the next appointment if decided upon.
criteria.title: Follow-Up

criteria.description: Any adjustments made to medications or interventions.
criteria.title: Adjustment of medication/intervention

criteria.description: Assignments or activities for the client to work on between the sessions.
criteria.title: Homework

icare_sections.description: Name, age, sex, marital status, education, where they live, contact details, and who came with them.
icare_sections.title: Patient particulars

icare_sections.description: Hospital and its id, whether this is outpatient, inpatient, telepsychiatry or clinic, room and bed number, date of assessment.
icare_sections.title: Clinical identifiers

icare_sections.description: Who sent the patient here and why -- an earlier clinician or hospital, or a school, workplace, legal or administrative route.
icare_sections.title: Referral information

icare_sections.description: The clinician seeing the patient now, and their hospital and department.
icare_sections.title: Therapist information

icare_sections.description: What kind of session this is -- intake, assessment, follow-up -- and what happened in the sessions before it.
icare_sections.title: Past session information

icare_sections.description: The symptoms the patient reports, each with how long it has been going on.
icare_sections.title: Presenting complaints (symptoms)

icare_sections.description: Relevant background: earlier illness and treatment, family history, personal history.
icare_sections.title: History

icare_sections.description: Risk of harm to self or others: suicidal thoughts with their duration, frequency and severity, and how the patient copes with them.
icare_sections.title: Crisis markers

icare_sections.description: What the clinician observes in the room: appearance, behaviour, mood, affect, speech, thought content.
icare_sections.title: Current mental status examination

icare_sections.description: Which school of therapy is being used -- dynamic, cognitive, behavioural, exposure, and so on.
icare_sections.title: Psychotherapy type

icare_sections.description: The specific techniques used this session: psychoeducation, reflective listening, behavioural activation, thought challenging, journaling.
icare_sections.title: Psychotherapy technique

icare_sections.description: Any scale or test administered -- IQ, personality, disability, projective.
icare_sections.title: Assessments

icare_sections.description: What the session was actually about.
icare_sections.title: Issues discussed in current session

icare_sections.description: What the therapist thought about the session afterwards.
icare_sections.title: Reflections by the therapist

icare_sections.description: The diagnosis the reviewing clinician assigns.
icare_sections.title: Clinical diagnosis by reviewer

icare_sections.description: What is recommended for the patient from here.
icare_sections.title: Action plan

icare_sections.description: When the next session is and what it will cover.
icare_sections.title: Next session details

sections.description: In this section, document the subjective reports from the client, their family members, and past medical records. Include how the client describes their feelings and current symptoms.
sections.name: Subjective

sections.description: This section is for recording objective observations made during the session. Note any factual, observable information, such as the client's appearance, behavior, mood, affect, and speech patterns. Avoid including any subjective statements or self-reported information from the client.
sections.name: Objective

sections.description: In this section, integrate the subjective and objective information to provide a comprehensive analysis of the client's current condition. Summarize your clinical impressions and hypotheses regarding the client's issues.
sections.name: Assessment

sections.description: Outline the next steps for the client's treatment. Include both short-term and long-term goals, specifying what will be addressed in the next session as well as overall treatment objectives. Be clear and specific about your expectations and the client’s goals for the duration of treatment.
sections.name: Plan
